properties.name: Coldcart
properties.description:
Coldcart is the operating system for perishable parcel logistics. We automate, execute, and optimize temperature-sensitive shipping across food, healthcare, and other high-risk categories where delivery integrity, compliance, and cost are mission critical.

Perishable fulfillment has long forced a trade-off between cost and reliability. Companies overpack and expedite to reduce spoilage, or incorrectly standardize and consolidate to reduce spend, often refunding 5–15%+ of perishable sales due to late or compromised deliveries.

Coldcart eliminates that trade-off by treating every shipment as an individual decision - fully automated, without adding process steps or requiring interaction.

Our platform orchestrates packaging, routing, carriers, warehouses, and vendors in real time, automating complex SOPs and creating a system of record for what was planned, executed, and delivered.

Customers use Coldcart to reduce total cost per shipment by 20–50% and cut late and spoiled shipment refunds by 40–60%, while gaining full visibility and control across their fulfillment network.

Coldcart fits into any existing tech stacks and combination of vendors.

Coldcart was founded by Jason Park (created and scaled Allstate Identity Protection, ex-Bain, ex-McMaster-Carr), Matt Salzberg (Blue Apron founder/former CEO), and Andy Salamon (Hims & Hers co-founder).
